scope: Where work_cases comparison conditions come from: quantity/unit, mandatory conditions, company policy. Agents read only work_cases (get_work_case); DB functions fill it.

quantity.source: Incumbent increase notice (INITIAL mail) supply quantity extracted by INFO_EXTRACTOR as available_quantity, e.g. "11월 공급 계획 1,000kg에 대해 5,000원에서 5,500원으로 인상" -> quantity 1000, unit kg.
rules: KAN-131: explicitly entered buyer quantity and unit override the supply quantity. If omitted, preserve the existing extraction fallback.
store_case_graph_quote fills work_cases.quantity/unit from record.case_conditions only when they are empty.
unit is the quantity unit; if absent, the same mail price unit.
Alternative supplier replies never set the case quantity; their available_quantity is only a supply capacity check.
Missing quantity may produce CONDITIONS_MISSING. API-06 can save comparison conditions; continuing the review is a separate operation.

company_items.purpose: Buyer-side required conditions per purchased item. Not supplier attributes.

columns.standardized_item_key: text, same key space as supplier_items.standardized_item_key

linking: INFO_EXTRACTOR links the quote to the supplier registered item and sends supplier_item_id only when one item is decided. If work_cases.standardized_item_key is set, it considers only registered items with the same key (names are not compared, KAN-190/191). Otherwise (first extraction) it considers items whose name matches after removing all whitespace and lowercasing (same as internal.item_name_norm). Several candidates are narrowed by specification. On first extraction it also sends the linked item's standardized_item_key in case_conditions.

store_case_graph_quote copies company_items.mandatory_conditions_jsonb and specification into empty work_cases fields for that key. No company_items row: conditions stay empty (comparison without required conditions).
company_items.registration: Seed data by SQL for MVP; no CRUD API in this scope.

policy_jsonb.max_increase_rate: decimal string. Accepted increase rate; a requested increase at or below it is a recommendation to accept, above it the counter-offer upper bound is previous price x (1 + rate).
policy_jsonb.incumbent_premium_rate: decimal string. Incumbent may stay up to this much above the alternative; competitive line = keep ceiling x (1 + rate).
policy_jsonb.preferred_origin: text, PROPOSED key name. ② CANDIDATE preferred origin; absent -> '국내산'.
policy_jsonb.origin_weight: decimal string, PROPOSED. Score added when origin matches preferred_origin; absent, non-numeric or negative -> '2'.
policy_jsonb.history_weight: decimal string, PROPOSED. Score added when purchase history exists; absent, non-numeric or negative -> '1'. Preference weights only order candidates and never offset a required-condition FAIL.

company_policy.snapshot: submit_case_graph_start writes the defaults as constants into work_cases.policy_jsonb at START. A company policy table may replace the constants later without agent changes.

counter_offer_statuses.PROPOSABLE: counter-offer within allowed_range [previous, min(requested, previous x (1+max_increase_rate), competitive line if inside)]; above_alternative=true when the whole range is above the competitive line
counter_offer_statuses.NOT_NEEDED: requested price already cheaper than the alternative: COUNTER_OFFER_SKIPPED
counter_offer_statuses.NO_POLICY: no max_increase_rate: HOLD with reference calculation only
counter_offer_statuses.PREVIOUS_UNKNOWN / COSTS_UNKNOWN / NOT_C: recheck source, ask evidence, or HOLD

api_04.request: expected_revision, optional quantity (positive decimal string, 14 integer and 6 fractional digits), unit, due_date (ISO date). Quantity and unit are paired.
api_04.storage: Existing submit_case_graph_start signature for revision-only requests. When conditions are present, send p_conditions JSONB to the extended signature; missing signature returns 503 START_CONDITIONS_INTEGRATION_REQUIRED. Save explicit conditions and immutable START receipt atomically before enqueue. No overwrite by extraction.
api_04.idempotency: Canonical quantity/unit/date included in submit and lookup hashes. Revision-only hashes remain compatible.

api_06.request: PATCH conditions with expected_revision, changes (quantity, unit, due_date), optional reason and string-array evidence_refs, Idempotency-Key.
api_06.storage: Reuse KAN-136 submit_work_revision EDIT_CONDITIONS. Check ownership and revision, persist the change and invalidate the prior review atomically. Dev migration 20261106150401 does not schedule PLAN automatically after condition edits.
api_06.resume: Candidate reselection, automatic PLAN scheduling, and treatment of unsent drafts are separate follow-up policies.
